Flow: Static and server-rendered marketing, career, and customer support pages under the `(public)` route group (excluding `expert-review`).

## Rules
1. **Scope Boundary:** Covers `/blog`, `/blog/[slug]`, `/careers`, `/contact-us`, `/help`, `/privacy-policy`, and `/terms-and-conditions`. The `/expert-review` domain is managed separately by `fe-page-expert-review`.
2. **Contact Inquiry Submission:** Contact forms post to backend `POST /v1/contact/` with structured Pydantic DTO validation.

## Known Traps
- **Career applications:** Job application modal buttons on `/careers` are visual stubs without an active backend resume submission endpoint.
